tiers.name: SPARK
tiers.effect: Deal 1d6 + RES modifier damage to one target.

tiers.name: SURGE
tiers.effect: Deal 2d6 + RES modifier to one target; d4 splash to all enemies adjacent to target.

tiers.name: STORM
tiers.effect: Deal 3d6 + RES modifier to all enemies in radius.

tiers.name: CASCADE
tiers.effect: Deal 4d6 + RES modifier to one target; if target dies, chain 4d6 to nearest enemy (repeats until no kill).

tiers.name: OBLITERATE
tiers.effect: Deal 5d6 + RES modifier to one target; ignores Defense bonuses (armor, cover, SHIELDED).

tiers.name: PATCH
tiers.effect: Heal 1d6 + RES modifier HP to one ally.

tiers.name: BARRIER
tiers.effect: Apply SHIELDED to one ally.

tiers.name: BULWARK
tiers.effect: Apply SHIELDED to all allies in radius; +2 Defense for 2 turns.

tiers.name: REGEN
tiers.effect: Target ally heals 1d6 + RES modifier HP at start of each turn for a number of turns equal to tier (4 turns).

tiers.name: FORTRESS
tiers.effect: All allies in radius gain +4 Defense and condition immunity for 2 turns.

tiers.name: PING
tiers.effect: Reveal all enemies in range (ignores LOS) for 1 turn.

tiers.name: TAG
tiers.effect: Apply MARKED to one enemy.

tiers.name: BLIND
tiers.effect: Apply BLINDED to one enemy (FIN save negates).

tiers.name: REVEAL
tiers.effect: Reveal entire floor layout, all containers, and descent point.

tiers.name: ORACLE
tiers.effect: All enemies revealed and MARKED for 3 turns.

tiers.name: FLIP
tiers.effect: Swap positions with one ally.

tiers.name: PURGE
tiers.effect: Remove one condition from one ally.

tiers.name: OVERRIDE
tiers.effect: Apply PANICKED to one enemy (FOC save negates).

tiers.name: NULLIFY
tiers.effect: All enemies in radius lose 2 AP on their next turn.

tiers.name: REFORMAT
tiers.effect: Reshape one 3×3 area: convert wall cells to floor or floor to wall. Cannot create disconnected areas.
